item.title: Singapore Motorshow 2026 Revs Up As Chinese Brands Take Center Stage
item.description: Excitement is building as the Singapore Motorshow 2026 returns in just six days. The region’s first motor show is taking place this January 8 to 11, 2026 at the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre.Read More »

item.description: As several car manufacturers including Honda, Suzuki, Tesla, and now Chery releasing their respective results from the fuel eco run conducted by the Department of Energy last September, it’s only prudent for you, our readers, to find out exactly how each car ranked.Read More »

item.title: BYD Is Now The World's Best-Selling EV Brand
item.description: BYD is now the world’s top EV brand, overtaking Tesla in full-year 2025 sales. This is based on sales data released by the two automakers.Read More »

item.title: Alpina Is Now Officially A Part Of The BMW Group
item.description: After announcing its purchase way back in 2022, it’s now official: Alpina is now known as BMW Alpina.Read More »

item.title: Korean Automaker KGM Motors Licenses BYD Tech For Hybrid SUVs
item.description: KGM Motors, the brand formerly known as SsangYong may not be in the Philippines anymore, but elsewhere they’ve started to beef up their electrification plans. After releasing battery electric vehicles, they’ve now started dabbling into hybrid electric vehicles as well. But to do so, they’ve chosen to partner with an unlikely ally: BYD.Read More »

item.title: The 2026 Changan Nevo Q05 Is A Solid PHEV Crossover Bogged Down By Some Quirks
item.description: Changan has entered their electrified era in the Philippines with the introduction of their “Nevo” sub-brand. This is focused on offering not just electrified but modern vehicles. The Q05 crossover fits this ethos well with its plug-in hybrid powertrain and future-forward design. However, it’s riddled with quirks at every stop.Read More »

item.title: Isuzu Zamboanga Gets New Look
item.description: Isuzu Philippines Corporation (IPC), together with dealer partner Izu South Motors Corporation, has officially reopened its Zamboanga City Dealership, now refreshed with a full Isuzu Outlet Standard (IOS)–compliant design. The launch marks another milestone in Isuzu’s “Road to 50” initiative, which aims to expand and modernize the company’s nationwide dealer network in line with the evolving demands of rapidly developing regions.Read More »

item.title: Volkswagen Reembraces Physical Switches As New Euro NCAP Requirements Take Effect
item.description: Carmakers who thought that touchscreens are the future, are starting to double back. The clearest case is with the all-new ID. Polo—Volkswagen’s newest EV that brings back tactile buttons and switches. It will definite the interior concept of upcoming Volkswagen EV models moving forward.Read More »

item.title: TMP Foundation Mobi-Care Program Enhances Basic Health Services In Santa Rosa And Batangas
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) Foundation launches its new ‘Mobi-Care’ (“Mobility with Care”) program with the turnover of four brand-new Toyota vehicles to the city governments of Santa Rosa and Batangas. These duly configured service vehicles are aimed at aiding the local governments in delivering public health services through enhanced mobility.Read More »

item.title: These THACO Sleeper Buses Now Service The Manila To Bicol Route
item.description: BJ Mercantile, Inc. (BJM), the official distributor of Thaco commercial vehicles in the Philippines, has officially turned over the country’s first two Thaco sleeper buses to Cagsawa Travel and Tours, Inc., setting a new standard for stylish, comfortable, and convenient travel between Manila and the Bicol Region.
